en: A mixture of cornstarch and water acts like a solid when punched but flows like a liquid when poured.
Heating white sugar causes a chemical change that transforms the crystals into black carbon and releases water vapor.
Solid water is less dense than liquid water, which is exactly why ice cubes float in a glass.
Mayonnaise is an emulsion, a unique mixture where tiny drops of liquid oil are permanently suspended in vinegar.
The sun is made of plasma, a superheated state of matter where electrons separate from their atoms.
Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide that undergoes sublimation, turning directly into a cold gas without becoming a liquid.
Water molecules stick tightly together due to surface tension, allowing lightweight insects like water striders to walk on ponds.
Aerogel is a synthetic solid made mostly of trapped air, making it one of the lightest solid materials on Earth.
The metal gallium melts into a liquid puddle in your hand because its melting point is just below human body temperature.
Nitinol is a metal alloy that remembers its original shape and automatically unbends when heated above a specific temperature.
Dipping a rubber ball in liquid nitrogen freezes it so completely that it shatters like glass when dropped.
Black marker ink is a hidden mixture of multiple colored dyes that separate into a rainbow on wet paper.
